ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/off-white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes; thick black pigment bands follow the trailing edges and lateral tips; dense black mottling and radial striations emerge from the central notch area toward the lobe centers.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree angle, with the specific vertex point partially obscured by white-water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations between 10 and 25 units creating a jagged profile isolated against the sky and water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curves fitted to both lobes, transitioning to slightly hooked, upward-tending lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of 3-5 small, high-intensity circular pixel groups (likely barnacle scars) on the far-left lateral tip; isolated white circular markers on the far-right lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe; one prominent diagonal dark line on the lower-left lobe emerging from the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe and significant edge scarring/irregularity on both lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'feathered' or brush-stroke texture at the interior boundaries where the black and white pigmentation fields meet.
